free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 100 requests daily, 3 articles per news request, top stories, all news and similar-news endpoints, real-time and historical data.
free_tier.notes: Each call to access or search news data adds 1 request to the daily usage. The headlines endpoint is documented as available on the Standard plan and above. The next plan up is Basic at USD 19 a month for 2,500 requests daily and 25 articles per request.

per_object_cap.stated: 3 articles per news request on the Free plan; an article carries a snippet of its first 60 characters, not the body
per_object_cap.notes: A result set cannot exceed 20,000 articles, so the highest page is 20,000 divided by the page size.

retention.stated: no retention or history window is stated for the Free plan; the pricing page lists historical data on every plan

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.thenewsapi.com/v1/news (top, all, similar, uuid, sources); the key goes in the api_token parameter; answers are UTF-8 JSON with dates in UTC
chaining: Article metadata with a title, a description, a 60-character snippet, the source URL and a uuid; the full article is fetched from the source URL by a crawler.

limits.value: 100 requests daily on the Free plan
unverified: a per-minute limit exists (HTTP 429 for too many requests in the past 60 seconds) and its size is read from the X-RateLimit-Limit header, which needs a key
3 articles per request on the Free plan; at most 20,000 articles in one result set

binding_note: 100 requests a day is met first; at 3 articles a request that is at most 300 articles a day.

identity_cost.detail: The pages say no billing details are required on the free plan.

reliability_note: Over the daily usage the API answers HTTP 402 usage_limit_reached, and over the per-minute limit HTTP 429 rate_limit_reached; a call with no token answered HTTP 401 invalid_api_token.
confidence_note: Quota, article cap, snippet length, error codes and register fields are read from first-party pages; a call with no token answered HTTP 401, so the free key was not exercised. A call with a free key would move this to measured.
